operations.mode: Optional continue-on-error capture and grading after existing successful weekly-pick publication; preserve only separate research observations and evaluations
operations.initialCapture: The original frozen manifest records the initial manual capture. This companion records subsequent automatic research integration without modifying that coefficient freeze.
operations.verification: Local capture, grading and tests passed before activation. First scheduled execution is future operational evidence; failures must remain visible as research warnings and do not imply a validated result.
